marine.title: Forecast for Tonight and Thursday.
marine.text:
Wind light becoming south 10 to 15 knots early Thursday
afternoon. Scattered flurries ending overnight. Scattered flurries
Thursday evening. Fog banks forming after midnight and dissipating Thursday
afternoon. Visibility as low as 1 mile in flurries and 1 mile or less in fog
banks. Temperatures near minus 2. <br/>
